newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * NATO leaders opened a historic summit in Madrid expected to determine the Alliance's expansion into Eastern European territory.
The summit started without the 16 leaders agreeing on how many countries will be invited to join the alliance in the first wave of enlargement.
* Romanian President Emil Constantinescu left for Madrid in the afternoon. He said he trusted the summit would bring about a favourable decision in the long term for Romania.
Constantinescu also praised his country's efforts to qualify for NATO expansion and the unprecedented solidarity of all Romanians, inside the country or abroad, in their common goal.
* Constantinescu is due to attend the summit's sessions and also have a series of bilateral talks.
* The parliament resumed debates in the last week of an extraordinary session before the summer recess.
